text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the clouds are looking ominous.
We'd better hurry home before it starts pouring.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, I really can't stand lightning...!
My body just freezes up no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, I'm pathetic even to myself...
It won't fall near here, will it...?!
